paragraphs.text: Teshar is a Phyrexian aven cleric from Otaria , Dominaria .

Teshar is a theologian and missionary of the Order of the Ancestor, a Serran religious group dedicated to the belief that the goddess Serra and The Ancestor worshiped on the continent of Otaria were the same. A descendant of aven settlers who flew across the sea after the destruction of their homeland, Teshar has pledged to bring Serra's divine succor to all refugees and wanderers.
Teshar was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion . Teshar fought on the side of the invaders alongside Moira .
